summary.de: Godot-Fixture-Runs lesen potato.godot-performance.json und schreiben frame_time ins CON-001-Artifact. Fehlender Collector ist unsupported; Addon nur nach Confirm.
summary.en: Godot fixture runs read potato.godot-performance.json and write frame_time into the CON-001 artifact. A missing collector is unsupported; the addon is confirm-only.
